texts.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为违反星系法。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years.

The resources we extracted from the dead Tiyanki have been confiscated, and we have been issued a fine.

texts.zh: 我们在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
texts.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

summary.text:
# 缇扬奇猎杀 / Tiyanki kills

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/galactic_features_events.txt, events/galactic_community_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_fleet_destroyed_perp（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1664）触发 galactic_features.381（galactic_features_events.txt:3378-3424）：击毁缇扬奇国家的舰队，且击毁者没有重力陷阱船、战斗中无其他舰队。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

若击杀国是银河共同体成员且《缇扬奇保护法》生效 → galcom.107 “违反保护法”（十年内违反银河法）；否则（事件未在显示中）1天后 galactic_features.385 “缇扬奇被猎杀”：收获资源并按各国伦理改变好感。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 107 / 385 互斥。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 决议《缇扬奇害虫控制》生效时没有好感变化。

## 审阅记录 Review notes
